style.backgroundSystem: seamless paper sweep #FFFFFF for packshots and variant flat lays, peach-sugar panel #FDE3E7 for benefit and spec screens, cream studio board #F0EAE2 for numbered construction screens, neutral board #E7E1DA beside macro frames, disused railway and shutter street fields #A8563F / #B7A495 / #DAD7D2 only for the two worn lifestyle screens; one flat cherry block #E0475A may carry one headline, one block per screen, never a gradient and never a hue outside this list
style.direction: sweet-pop girls street apparel commerce, candy color blocking with clean infographic discipline
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in #2B2428 plus solid circular index chips in #E0475A on the numbered detail screens; no filled emblems, no seal realism, no certificate artwork, no badge wording
style.lightingSystem: warm daylight-balanced key around 5200K from the upper left, large softbox diffusion with a bounce fill on the shadow side, true contact shadow under every hem and folded edge, raking side light only on the two texture macro screens, no harsh speculars, no cool cast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent sweet-pop girls street apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless paper sweep #FFFFFF, peach-sugar panel #FDE3E7, cherry accent #E0475A and label ink #2B2428; warm daylight-balanced softbox key around 5200K from the upper left with bounce fill and true contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif with one rounded heavy display weight on poster screens only; thin single-weight line icons plus solid circular index chips in #E0475A; clean high-end children apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 worn angle and garment scale, generic child model cropped at the neck or seen from behind; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no new colorway outside the two reference colorways
no logo, wordmark or brand mark on garment, cap or bag
no identifiable child face in any screen
style.presentationRules: keep one garment scale and one slight 3/4 worn angle across the set so the outfit reads as the same pair; flat lays stay perfectly square to the frame; both pieces of the set appear together whenever the outfit is shown; every child model is a generic body cropped at the neck or seen from behind, never an identifiable face
style.surfaceSystem: matte paper sweep #FFFFFF, cream studio board #F0EAE2, neutral board #E7E1DA, weathered wooden sleeper #B7A495 with grey ballast gravel #C9C5BF for worn screens; garment faces stay flat, unwrinkled and lint-free, no debris inside the frame
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif for every Chinese and Latin label plus one rounded heavy display weight reserved for the two poster screens only; in-image Chinese always appears as 「{selling_point_N}」 or 「{callout_N}」; headline 28-48pt, subline 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, per-screen copy budget under 50 characters, no serif, handwritten or retro faces and no painted wall lettering
